research_question: Does the same cached Qwen checkpoint clear the frozen ARC-Challenge CPU base-feasibility gate on an untouched, disjoint validation sample after the v1 harness failed during summary aggregation?

decision_context.reason_for_candidate: ARC-Challenge is absent from the repository’s consumed-task inventory. The exact Qwen checkpoint has previously cleared a one-step GRPO update/save/reload smoke, so this is a new task pairing with a measured update path rather than an arbitrary new model screen.
decision_context.novelty_boundary: ARC-Challenge and greedy multiple-choice evaluation are established; this feasibility screen makes no novelty or capability claim. It decides whether the next real-model update gate is worth running.
decision_context.closest_prior_art: Clark et al., Think you have Solved Question Answering? Try ARC, the AI2 Reasoning Challenge (2018), https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.05457.
decision_context.v1_recovery: V1 generated 80 unique validation responses, then stopped with KeyError at summary aggregation because the prose protocol specified the 95% Wilson z value but omitted the machine-readable wilson_z field. The raw run is retained as an execution failure and its IDs are excluded here. No v1 score, prompt, parser, threshold, or runtime result is used to change this protocol.

dataset.split_rules: The runner downloads and reads only the validation parquet. It never reads train or test. Any later training protocol may read train; the benchmark test split must remain unopened until a separate confirmation protocol is frozen.

sample.eligibility: Exactly four options with ordered labels A, B, C, D.
sample.selection: Sort eligible validation rows by SHA256(selection_salt + "|" + row.id), then take the first 80. No label-aware sampling or replacement.
sample.repeat_policy: One deterministic greedy decode per selected item; no resampling or prompt repair.

prompt.system: Answer the science question by choosing one of the listed options. Reply with exactly one option label: A, B, C, or D. Do not explain.
prompt.chat_format: Use the pinned checkpoint tokenizer chat template with add_generation_prompt=True.

generation.truncation: Fail before scoring any row whose prompt reaches the maximum input length.
generation.answer_parser: After trimming whitespace, optionally remove one outer triple-backtick code fence and an optional prefix "Answer:", "The answer is:", or "The correct answer is". Accept only a full remaining string matching one letter A-D with optional parentheses and a terminal period or right parenthesis. Explanations and multiple labels are unparsed.

metrics.primary: Exact accuracy over all 80 rows; unparsed output counts incorrect.
metrics.baseline: Uniform four-choice chance = 0.25. No labels are used to construct a prediction baseline.

acceptance.gate_if_pass: Authorize only a separately protocol-locked update-cost smoke (gradient, adapter/checkpoint save-reload, and post-reload exact-answer check). This gate does not authorize a full training comparison.
acceptance.gate_if_fail: Retire this exact model/task/prompt/parser pairing; do not tune or rerun on the opened sample.

failure_criteria: Any model, dataset, source, or runtime revision mismatch.
Fewer than 80 eligible items or duplicate IDs.
Any prompt truncation, non-finite model output, exception, or incomplete raw record.
Exact accuracy below 0.35 or 95% Wilson lower bound not strictly above 0.25.
claim_limits: This is a base-only feasibility gate on one opened validation sample, not an update or learning result.
A pass does not authorize full training and does not establish real-model capability improvement.
ARC-Challenge is public; pretraining contamination cannot be ruled out.
No conclusion about general reasoning or science ability follows from this 80-item screen.
Same-author local audit is not external reproduction.
